evolution.missing_field_semantics: Absent optional fields select null primitive behavior
evolution.sequence_semantics: Contiguous request-local event sequence beginning at zero

snapshot_at.description: Unix seconds captured for this request's sweep before remote probes begin

seat.description: The direct current seat projection from caduceus.ruyi.v1; this nested object has no row/envelope schema kernel.

perspective.description: A stored raw published perspective, or null on member events when none is stored

begin.description: event is begin; emitted before any remote probe starts

member.description: event is member; member is a fully observed announced or discovered Ruyi staff row

complete.description: event is complete; roster is the ordinary full caduceus.ruyi.v1 response

failed.description: event is failed; terminal for this stream, never a partial complete roster

canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, two-space indentation and one trailing LF. GET schema serves these exact file bytes.
